fields.description: The month this reading belongs to, as YYYY-MM. Re-running the audit inside the same month replaces that month's rows rather than adding to them.
fields.label: Period

fields.description: SIM Type. Empty means the SIM had no plan set when the reading was taken.
fields.label: Plan

fields.description: The ERP Item behind the SIM — Lebara, STC, Mobily. Empty means no Item was recorded.
fields.label: Carrier

fields.description: Only Active and Suspend are billed, so only they are recorded.
fields.label: SIM Status

fields.description: When the reading was taken — the audit run it came from.
fields.label: Captured At

fields.description: Unticked means no tariff was on file for this plan and carrier, so Cost is zero because the price was unknown — not because the SIMs were free.
fields.label: Priced

fields.description: The per-SIM price AS IT WAS when this reading was taken. Stored rather than looked up, so correcting a tariff later does not rewrite past months.
fields.label: Price Used

fields.description: Of those SIMs, how many sat behind a device the ERP had deleted or whose subscription had expired.
fields.label: Wasted SIMs
